subject: Standard QM/QFT + decoherence (baseline)

twelve_questions.1_physically_real: Quantum states of fields/particles + their unitary evolution + observed measurement statistics. No extra ontology beyond the standard formalism.
twelve_questions.2_primitive_variables: State vector / density operator on Hilbert space; observables as operators; unitary dynamics.
twelve_questions.3_fundamental_dynamics: Unitary Schrodinger evolution (operator evolution in QFT). No collapse dynamics.
twelve_questions.4_probabilities_from: Born postulate: p_i = <psi|P_i|psi>. POSTULATE, not derived within this framework. [von Neumann 1932; Dirac 1930]
twelve_questions.5_definite_outcomes: NOT supplied. Decoherence suppresses interference (DERIVED: Zurek 1981/2003; Joos-Zeh 1985; Zurek Rev Mod Phys 75, 715 (2003)) but the global state remains an entangled superposition. Matches the Experiment P / RC-04 scoped result, independently reproducible from standard EID theory.
twelve_questions.6_recovers_unitary_sector: TRIVIAL - it is the unitary sector.
twelve_questions.7_recovers_classicality: PARTIAL - decoherence explains apparent classicality of records (EFFECTIVE), but not the selection of a realized outcome.
twelve_questions.8_additional_inputs_beyond_Cbp: ZERO dynamical addition; the Born postulate is standard QM, not an addition to Cbp.
twelve_questions.10_novel_predictions: None for outcome selection. The cross-term formula rho_01 ~ alpha beta* <E1|E0> is standard EID [Zurek 2003], not a novel prediction of an outcome ontology.
twelve_questions.11_falsification: No outcome-selection mechanism exists to falsify; framework is silent on definite outcomes.
twelve_questions.12_unexplained_remainder: Definite outcome: UNRESOLVED. Origin of Born weights: POSTULATE. Measurement record: explained only as decohered entanglement, not as a realized event.

explanatory_gain_itemized.measurement_record_explained: PARTIAL (records as entangled/decohered branches, not realized events)

scoring.compression: 0/2 = 0 (no gain over the door problem; the Born postulate is cost without outcome-selection gain)

hypothesis_test: H5 CONFIRMED: zero structure cost (beyond standard QM), zero outcome gain. This is the baseline against which all compression is measured.
